env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=

cd forbid
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

cd res
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build -o ok.bin ./ok
[cgo] ! logos build ./bad
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] package example\.com/m/bad uses cgo and is not in cgo_allowlist'
cd ..

cd res
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
[cgo] logos build -o ok.bin ./ok
[cgo] ! logos build ./bad
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] package example\.com/m/bad uses cgo and is not in cgo_allowlist'
cd ..

cd allow
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
[cgo] logos build .
cd ..

cd nokey
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

cd gom
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build .
[cgo] go build .
cd ..

cd goign
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build .
cd ..

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/cgoforbid

go 1.27

-- forbid/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbid/main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("forbid:", C.answer()) }

-- res/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27

-- res/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "restricted"
cgo_allowlist = ["example.com/m/ok/**"]

-- res/ok/ok.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("ok:", C.answer()) }

-- res/bad/bad.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("bad:", C.answer()) }
